# Reporting Tool Lite HTTP API

## Overview

Operations and financial reports for one mining site, read from its MDK workers.

Every path is relative to `/apps/reporting`, where the Gateway serves these routes. The OpenAPI 3.1 document is
[`openapi.json`](openapi.json).

Purpose is the operation's declared description. Access is the `spec.rbac` requirement the Gateway checks, a verb on a resource; it does not
mean any particular caller is allowed. "Not declared" marks something the declaration does not state.

## Operations

| Method | Path | Purpose | Access | Request | Responses |
| ------ | ---- | ------- | ------ | ------- | --------- |
| `GET` | `/api/reporting/site` | The site: name, timezone, mining units, miner types present, which data sources are wired, and how far back history goes | `get` on `reporting/api/reporting/site` | Bearer token | `200`, `503` |
| `GET` | `/api/reporting/operations` | Hashrate, power, efficiency, nominal values and miner status per period bucket, for the site, each mining unit and each miner type | `get` on `reporting/api/reporting/operations` | Bearer token, `start` (query), `end` (query), `granularity` (query) | `200`, `400`, `503` |
| `GET` | `/api/reporting/miners` | The fleet as of the latest sample: miner counts per type by status and power mode, power per type | `get` on `reporting/api/reporting/miners` | Bearer token, `refresh` (query) | `200`, `503` |
| `GET` | `/api/reporting/consumption` | Energy per power meter per period bucket, in MWh, with the site meter apart | `get` on `reporting/api/reporting/consumption` | Bearer token, `start` (query), `end` (query), `granularity` (query) | `200`, `400`, `503` |
| `GET` | `/api/reporting/financials` | Pool payouts, subsidy / fee split, revenue at production-date price, network hashprice, energy, hashrate and Cost Input costs per period bucket, with every per-MWh and per-PH/s/day figure | `get` on `reporting/api/reporting/financials` | Bearer token, `start` (query), `end` (query), `granularity` (query) | `200`, `400`, `503` |
| `GET` | `/api/reporting/costs` | Cost Input for one year: monthly energy and operations cost in USD, twelve months | `get` on `reporting/api/reporting/costs` | Bearer token, `year` (query) | `200`, `400`, `503` |
| `PUT` | `/api/reporting/costs` | Sets monthly energy and operations cost (USD) for months of one year, in the app's own store; answers the whole year. The app's only write: it never reaches MDK or a device | `update` on `reporting/api/reporting/costs` | Bearer token, JSON body (required) | `200`, `400`, `503` |

## Errors

The application error codes the operations declare, the HTTP status each arrives with, when it fires and what the caller does about it. "Not
declared" marks what the declaration does not state.

An error response's body is `{ statusCode, error, message }`:

- `statusCode`: The HTTP status, repeated
- `error`: The HTTP status text, such as `Bad Request`
- `message`: The `ERR_*` code, followed by `: ` and a detail when there is one. For a request that fails the route's schema, the validation
  message instead.

| Code | Status | Operations | Fires when | Fix |
| ---- | ------ | ---------- | ---------- | --- |
| `ERR_APP_NOT_READY` | `503` | `GET /api/reporting/site`, `GET /api/reporting/operations`, `GET /api/reporting/miners`, `GET /api/reporting/consumption`, `GET /api/reporting/financials`, `GET /api/reporting/costs`, `PUT /api/reporting/costs` | the app's store is not open yet | Not declared |
| `ERR_BAD_COSTS` | `400` | `GET /api/reporting/costs`, `PUT /api/reporting/costs` | `GET /api/reporting/costs`: `year` is outside the years Cost Input covers; `PUT /api/reporting/costs`: `year` is missing or outside the years Cost Input covers, `months` is empty, a month is outside 1 to 12 or appears twice, or a cost is not a non-negative number or null | Not declared |
| `ERR_BAD_RANGE` | `400` | `GET /api/reporting/operations`, `GET /api/reporting/consumption`, `GET /api/reporting/financials` | `start` is not before `end`, or the range is too long for the granularity (hour: 93 days, others: 3 years) | Not declared |
